answer: Random peer audit stops fake identities. A newcomer posts a 50-token bond and joins a grove of verified agents, paid after 20 honest epochs. Each epoch a beacon draws five auditors who wander through its work; a fake built of cheap timber fails, its bond split among the auditors, and a lying auditor loses its own bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 tokens and most fakes are caught. An honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its full earnings.
